name: K class (steam submarine)
axes: right-handed: X longitudinal/bow-positive; Y up; Z transverse
dimensionBasis: Existing recognition drawing dimensions (see its measurement caveats)

reference.configuration: Surfaced early K-class interpretation with the two retractable steam funnels raised, forward conning tower and two 4-inch deck guns. External lines and equipment stations checked against the 1918 Vickers profile/deck plan. The game fit has eight internal torpedo tubes; removed deck tubes are not added. Simplified plan fittings are original interpretations.
reference.note: Stylized class interpretation guided by catalog dimensions, armament and the linked recognition reference; not an engineering plan or exact reconstruction. Continuous hull/deck surfaces, shaped housings and round fittings are original polygon interpretations of the same documented stations.
